instructions: There are NINE questions in this paper.

subQuestions.text: Which of these, best describes an array?

What is the output of the following program?
void main(){
int a;
a=1;
while(a<=1)
if(a%2)
printf("%d", a++);
else
printf("%d", ++a);
printf("%d", a+10);
}

What is the output of following program?
#include <stdio.h>
int main()
{
int a=1;
int b=1;
int c=a || --b;
int d=a-- && --b;
printf("a=%d, b=%d, c=%d, d=%d", a, b, c, d);
return 0;
}
